purpose: Blizzlike creature melee damage. Upstream migration sql/updates/world/4.3.4/2025_06_18_06_world.sql (commit 68a3622133) set creature_template.DamageModifier to 1 for all 46,627 templates, pending re-evaluation. Every boss, add and trash template is uncalibrated until an entry here says otherwise. Check every new boss and its adds against this registry.
consumers: tools/bot_ml/live_validation_fidelity.py: report.json and combat_analysis.json encounter_fidelity (preflight, boss_melee, blizzlike)
tools/raid_program/scoreboard_record.py and scoreboard_show.py: per-kill fidelity status, informational only
tools/raid_program/scenario_bootstrap.py: encounter_damage_fidelity requirement of new scenarios

statuses.calibrated: damage_modifier is derived from a matched same-mode WCL sample; the world DB must hold exactly this value
statuses.open: not derived yet; the DB keeps the upstream value (normally 1) and runs with it are not Blizzlike
statuses.not_applicable: the creature has no melee or weapon damage, so DamageModifier has no effect; reason required

method.wcl_field: unmitigatedAmount (U) of landed melee rows (WCL ability 1)
method.stage_note: U is before the target's armor, block, damage-taken reductions and absorbs. Attacker-side -10% physical done auras (Scarlet Fever 81130, Demoralizing Roar 99, Demoralizing Shout 1160, Vindication 26017) are inside both U and the native after-attacker stage. The native stage is computed before the outcome roll, so parried, dodged and missed swings are valid roll samples too.
steps: Pick a same-mode WCL kill (same size and difficulty, post-4.2 tuning era). List the boss melee rows with U, hit type and the attacker-side -10% auras active at the time.

Take the native per-swing roll at DamageModifier 1 from melee_resolution attacker_published_min/max_damage, or compute it: (gt_npc_damage_by_class_expN[level][class] * {1, 1.5} + AP / 14 * BaseVariance) * BaseAttackTime_s.

Lower bound = largest unreduced U / native max. Upper bound = smallest U taken under a -10% done aura / (0.9 * native min). Choose a value inside both bounds, also after the native +1% auto-attack bonus.
Cross-check with a weapon-percent ability that ignores caster modifiers when the encounter has one (Magmaw: Mangle 89773).

Stage an idempotent single-entry UPDATE under sql/custom/staged/world with the derivation in its header, record it here as calibrated, and confirm on a live kill that encounter_fidelity.boss_melee shows the after-attacker stage within +-10% of WCL.
A creature that never swings (vehicle part, stalker, caster without melee) is not_applicable with the evidence in reason.
method.difficulty_entries: Each difficulty template (difficulty_entry_1..3) has its own DamageModifier and often a different BaseAttackTime. Calibrate each from its own mode's sample; never copy another mode's value.
method.wcl_mean_basis: wcl_melee_reference.u_mean is the WCL sample mean when recorded. Without it, per-run reports compare the native mean with the midpoint of the WCL envelope and label the basis wcl_envelope_midpoint.

evidence.bounds_derivation: lower = 178,540 / 11,273.7 (largest hit, unreduced); upper = 111,531 / (0.9 * 7,588.8) (smallest hit under Scarlet Fever)
evidence.cross_check: Mangle 89773 initial hit U 240,338 / 1.5 = 160,225 per unmodified swing; at modifier 16 that is a native roll of 10,014, inside 7,589-11,274
evidence.replay: 70 native swings from base-0891a99 kills 1-3 scaled by 16 give 110,512-181,904 at the U stage

wcl_melee_reference.meaning: observed sample envelope, not recovered roll endpoints
